We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts. The facts: defendant Wang introduced others to virtually issue VAT special invoices for a company, total amount 1,244,526 yuan, tax 180,828.63 yuan, used for tax deduction, causing tax loss. Also seized many forged invoices (machine printed and ordinary). So crimes: 虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票 (as in many examples). Also possibly 伪造发票? In examples, they label "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票" for cases of false VAT invoices used for deduction. They also sometimes add "伪造发票" but not in examples. The label used for similar case: first example: "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". That covers both virtual issuance and using for deduction. Also there is "伪造发票" not shown. In examples, they never separate "伪造发票". So answer likely just that label.

Thus final answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票<eoa>
